scope: Review of all five contact sheets (73 decoded frames), full-resolution decoded frames 180, 360, 719, additional native poses, native and encoded boundary analysis. No claim of continuous audiovisual playback.
observations: Warm cabin composition is retained with stable straight furniture and window edges.
Multiple distinct tree distances move consistently from right to left behind the glass.
Cropped tree roots remain below the window; no open background gaps were observed.
Rain stays within the window and tea steam is located over the cup.
Cat movement is restricted to a subtle torso region.
No text, legacy cottage art, marine elements, scene cuts or bright flashing effects.
limitations: 1672x941 generated cabin source slightly enlarged to 1920x1080.
A few four-sprite tree forms recur in this 24-second loop.
Channel-wide adoption is conditional on the user reviewing this preview.
encoded_boundary_notes: Whole-frame first test was sensitive to IDR versus predicted-frame reconstruction noise. Moving-window seam is comparable to nearby frame changes; static native cabin is identical. The final checker measures these separately and bounds encoded cabin difference below one RGB level.
